data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘stella’ meaning ‘star’. The name Estella was popularized by the classic novel ‘Gulliver’s Travels’ where the main character, Gulliver, falls in love with a beautiful woman named Estella. In the Bible, the Star of Bethlehem guided the Magi to the birthplace of Jesus. The name Estella carries the meaning “Star” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Estella usually hope their child will grow to embody star and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Εστέλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εστέλα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'αστήρ' που σημαίνει αστέρι. Στη Καινή Διαθήκη, το αστέρι συνδέεται με τον Χριστό και την καθοδήγηση των Μάγων. Το όνομα Εστέλα συμβολίζει την πνευματική λαμπρότητα και την καθοδήγηση.

in_latin.name: Estella
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Estella a Latina voce 'stella' derivatur, quae stellam significat. In Ecclesia primitiva, stellae saepe cum Christo et Magis coniunguntur. Nomen Estella significat lucem, ductum et pulchritudinem.
